mainText: Hello, Verona! At 12 PM, we have clear skies near the Verona Area High School and an air quality index of 54, which is in the moderate range.

The City of Verona has officially adopted the Envision Verona Comprehensive Plan following a unanimous council vote. This long-term vision was developed with extensive public input to manage housing, transportation, and sustainability as the city grows.

Enjoy a busy weekend and early week with live music today at Bailey's Run Vineyard and Wisconsin Brewing Company. Looking ahead, yoga is scheduled for tomorrow at Insight Wellness, followed by various trivia nights at local spots like Hop Haus, Paddy Mac's, and The Mill early next week.

Reviewing the weekly police report, on October 3, a 19-year-old Verona man was arrested for being a felon in possession of a firearm after officers located him during a traffic stop for expired registration.
The Culver's flavor of the day is Caramel Cashew and you can stop by any time before they close at 10:00 PM to grab a scoop.
